method_card.title: Jobs and Work Experience
method_card.content:
This lesson covers job title vocabulary, work experience, and giving opinions about future work.

FrenchEnglish
un médecindoctor
un(e) infirmier / infirmièrenurse
un(e) professeur(e)teacher
un(e) avocat(e)lawyer
un(e) ingénieur(e)engineer
un(e) coiffeur / coiffeusehairdresser
un(e) vendeur / vendeusesales assistant
un(e) cuisinier / cuisinièrechef / cook
un stagework placement
le patron / la patronneboss
un(e) collèguecolleague
une entreprisecompany
le salairesalary
bien payé(e) (Higher)well paid

Feminine job titles: Key patterns to know — -eur → -euse (coiffeur → coiffeuse, vendeur → vendeuse), -ier → -ière (infirmier → infirmière, cuisinier → cuisinière), -teur → -trice (acteur → actrice). Some don't change: un/une médecin, un/une journaliste.

Talking about work experience (perfect tense): J'ai fait un stage dans… (I did a work placement in…). J'ai aidé les clients (I helped customers). J'ai appris beaucoup de choses (I learnt a lot of things). C'était une bonne expérience (It was a good experience — imperfect).

Model: J'ai fait un stage dans un magasin pendant une semaine. Mon patron était sympa et mes collègues étaient accueillants. J'ai appris beaucoup de choses utiles. À l'avenir, je voudrais devenir infirmière parce que j'aime aider les gens. (I did a work placement in a shop for a week. My boss was nice and my colleagues were welcoming. I learnt many useful things. In the future, I would like to become a nurse because I like helping people.)
steps: Learn job titles in both masculine and feminine forms
Know work experience vocabulary: stage, patron, collègue, entreprise
Practise describing work experience using the perfect tense (j'ai fait, j'ai appris)
Use the imperfect for descriptions in the past: c'était, mon patron était
Give opinions about jobs using je voudrais devenir + reason

exam_context.frequency: Very common in extended writing and speaking tasks about future plans

worked_examples.question: How do you make feminine job titles in French?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Three main patterns: -eur → -euse (coiffeur → coiffeuse), -ier → -ière (infirmier → infirmière), -teur → -trice (acteur → actrice).

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Some job titles don't change: un/une médecin, un/une journaliste, un/une scientifique.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Main patterns: -eur → -euse, -ier → -ière, -teur → -trice. Some job titles are the same for men and women.

worked_examples.question: Translate: 'À l'avenir, je voudrais devenir médecin.'

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: devenir médecin = to become a doctor. Note: in French, no article before a job title after devenir.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: In the future, I would like to become a doctor.

bronze.question: Match the French job titles to the English meaning
Match the French work experience vocabulary to the English meaning
Complete the sentence about future plans

gaps.correct_explain: voudrais = I would like (conditional). Je voudrais devenir = I would like to become.

wrong.veux: veux is present tense (I want). For future plans, the conditional voudrais sounds more sophisticated.
wrong.vais: vais is near future (I am going to). This sentence needs 'I would like', not 'I am going to'.

gaps.correct_explain: vais — je vais étudier = I am going to study (near future).

wrong.voudrais: The first gap already uses the conditional. This gap uses the near future for variety: je vais.

gaps.correct_explain: stage = work placement. J'ai fait un stage = I did a work placement.
patron = boss (masculine). Mon patron était sympa = My boss was nice.
collègues = colleagues. Mes collègues étaient sympas = My colleagues were nice.

bronze.question: What does 'Je voudrais devenir avocat parce que c'est un métier bien payé' mean?
options: I would like to become a lawyer because it is a well-paid job
I want to become a doctor because it is an interesting job
I would like to become a teacher because I like young people
I am going to become a lawyer because my parents want me to

model_answers: I did a work placement in a clothes shop for two weeks. I learnt many useful things.

silver.question: Complete the sentence by typing the correct verb form
silver.english: When I am older, I will work abroad.

gaps.correct_explain: serai is the simple future of être (je). After quand with a future meaning, French uses the future tense (unlike English).

wrong.suis: suis is present tense. After quand in a future context, use the future tense: serai.
wrong.serais: serais is conditional. The simple future ends in -ai: serai.

gaps.correct_explain: travaillerai = I will work. Infinitive travailler + future ending -ai.

wrong.travaille: travaille is present tense. 'I will work' needs the simple future: travaillerai.
wrong.travaillerais: travaillerais is conditional. The future ends in -ai: travaillerai.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: Ma sœur travaille comme coiffeur dans un salon de beauté.
silver.explanation: Ma sœur is feminine, so the job title must be in the feminine form: coiffeuse (not coiffeur). Pattern: -eur → -euse.
silver.translation: My sister works as a hairdresser in a beauty salon.

silver.question: Build the sentence in French
silver.english: I would like to become a teacher.

distractor_labels.veux: wrong register — veux is present tense (I want). For future plans, the conditional voudrais (I would like) is more appropriate

silver.source_text: I did a work placement in an office. I learnt many useful things. In the future, I would like to become an engineer.
model_answers: J'ai fait un stage dans un bureau. J'ai appris beaucoup de choses utiles. À l'avenir, je voudrais devenir ingénieur(e).

gold.question: Build the sentence in French
gold.english: The ideal would be to be a teacher because you can work with young people.

distractor_labels.est: wrong tense — est is present, but 'would be' needs the conditional: serait
distractor_labels.sera: wrong tense — sera is simple future, but 'would be' needs the conditional: serait

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are at a careers event. An advisor at an information stand asks you about your work experience and future plans.

bullets.prompt: Describe a work placement you did — where it was and what you did.
bullets.model_answer: J'ai fait un stage dans un magasin de vêtements pendant une semaine. J'ai aidé les clients et j'ai appris beaucoup de choses utiles.
bullets.note: passé composé: j'ai fait, j'ai aidé, j'ai appris; pendant + duration

bullets.prompt: Say what job you would like to do and give a reason.
bullets.model_answer: Je voudrais devenir infirmier(e) parce que j'aimerais aider les gens. C'est un métier important.
bullets.note: conditional: voudrais, aimerais; no article before job title after devenir

bullets.prompt: Say what you are going to do after school.
bullets.model_answer: Après le collège, je vais continuer mes études au lycée et ensuite j'irai à l'université.
bullets.note: near future: je vais + infinitive; simple future: j'irai; showing tense range

bullets.prompt: Ask the advisor what qualifications you need for a job in healthcare.
bullets.model_answer: Quels diplômes faut-il pour travailler dans le secteur de la santé?
bullets.note: quels + noun; il faut + infinitive for obligation; sector vocabulary
